questions.q: Which is an example of intensive farming?
options: Rice paddies with high labour input per hectare
questions.why: Intensive farming uses high labour or capital inputs on a small area to get high yields.

questions.q: Which is a human cause of food shortage?
questions.why: War and conflict disrupt farming and food supply; the others are physical.
Leakage is when tourism income leaves the local area, for example to overseas owners.

questions.q: Explain why a factory might locate in a special economic zone.
questions.model: Governments give tax breaks and grants in such zones, so costs are lower. They also provide good infrastructure and a labour supply, making production easier and cheaper.
